entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: I-I'm sorry... That was very much[n]unlike me...

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Sheesh... Weren't you the one tellin' us[n]not to go around touchin' shit in the[n]exhibit?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Urgh, that is true... I can't believe I made[n]such a novice mistake, even for solid[n]gold...

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: But something was drawing me to[n]this vase...

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: What do you mean...? Isn't it just an[n]ordinary gold vase?

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: I wonder if there's something special[n]about it. Should we take a closer look[n]just in case?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Oh, I see... So that's why I was drawn to it!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: I'll explain the rest of this later. Just get[n]after it and attack!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Good, good! That was pretty nice[n]considering it was your first time[n]running into one.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: That, Panther, was a rare Shadow that[n]occasionally resides in pricey items. I call[n]them [clr 2]Treasure Demons[clr 27].

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: They're great. Not only do they give you[n]a lot of experience, they might be useful[n]for your Personas too.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: However, they run very fast, and attacks[n]don't deal very much damage to them.

entries.speaker: Treasure Demons
entries.en: Sometimes [clr 2]Treasure Demons[clr 27] will be hidden[n]inside destructible objects within the Palaces.

entries.speaker: Treasure Demons
entries.en: Defeating them will give you a lot of experience[n]points. They also make excellent Persona fusion[n]material.

entries.speaker: Treasure Demons
entries.en: It is highly recommended that you actively[n]pursue them any time you come across one.
